items.passageEn: Last year, Ben went to Japan on a school trip. His father gave him some cash and a credit card. In Japan, Ben found that famous brands were very expensive, but food in small shops was cheap. He bought a shirt, but it was too big, so he went back to the shop for an exchange. He also visited a museum with no entrance fee. "You don't need great wealth to have a good time," he wrote to his father.
items.passageZh: 去年，Ben 參加學校旅行去了日本。爸爸給了他一些現金和一張信用卡。在日本，Ben 發現名牌很貴，但小店裡的食物很便宜。他買了一件襯衫，可是太大了，所以回店裡換貨。他還去了一間不收門票的博物館。他寫信跟爸爸說：「不需要很多財富，也能過得很開心。」

items.promptZh: 這個活動的報名費是兩百元。
referenceEn: The fee for this event is two hundred dollars.
This event has a fee of two hundred dollars.
rubricZh: 「報名費」可寫例如 fee、the fee for this event
金額可寫例如 two hundred dollars

items.promptZh: 我們家一直都喝同一個牌子的咖啡。
referenceEn: My family always drinks the same brand of coffee.
Our family has always drunk the same brand of coffee.
rubricZh: 用 brand 表示「牌子」（例如 the same brand of coffee）
時態可用現在式或現在完成式（例如 always drinks、has always drunk 等）
